Organize the 120m site into 4×4 districts, each at least 24m wide, connected by a readable road and path network with logical transitions between residential, agricultural, communal, and roadside areas. Prioritize composition, spatial continuity, material realism, asset variation, and object-level detail. Treat 'GTA6-level quality' as an aspirational visual target rather than a certifiable quality guarantee.
